response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong C/C++, Linux, and embedded background (National Instruments, robotics arms, low-level DLang work), but he lacks the mandatory native-level Japanese proficiency, has no demonstrated Linux kernel source-code modification experience, and no exposure to the specific security domains (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal, switch chips) required for this role. His profile is strongly web/product-engineering oriented in recent years, diverging from the embedded LAN-switch security focus of this position.
strengths: Solid C/C++ and Linux systems experience from earlier career (NI, robotics, low-level DLang networking)
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, testing tools) applicable to rigorous development lifecycle
Demonstrated ability to quickly master new technical domains across many varied roles
concerns: No evidence of native or working Japanese proficiency, a hard requirement
No demonstrated Linux kernel investigation/modification experience
No experience with required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, tamper detection) or switch/networking hardware

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel modification or embedded security experience
Strong general C/systems and software engineering fundamentals
